use_case_name: Initiate and Clear Surveillance Track Alerts

claims.content: To allow the C2 JU to initiate and clear alerts for surveillance tracks.

goal.raw_text: To allow the C2 JU to initiate and clear alerts for surveillance tracks.

claims.content: The C2 JU has received a surveillance track report from an external source (e.g., another C2 unit, sensor system).
The C2 JU has the capability to generate and display track alerts based on predefined criteria (e.g., threat level, proximity to friendly forces).
The C2 JU operator is logged into the system and has the necessary permissions to initiate and clear alerts.
The surveillance track data is being processed and displayed on the C2 JU's operational picture.
